integrity: All analytic claims are accompanied by a detailed proof and a standalone exact-rational checker. Numerical comparisons are supportive and do not certify the universal theorem.
scientific_limitations: Symmetric two-state switching; known harmonic relaxation rate; exact population snapshot moments; no finite-sample inference or asymmetric-switching generalization. Historical priority provisional for two partially inaccessible papers.
title: Sharp eighth-moment identifiability and feasibility cone for harmonically trapped switching diffusivity
